en.headline: Chief Secretary chairs first meeting of AI risk governance working group
en.dek: Chan Kwok-ki said the group will coordinate seven actions covering AI crime, minor protection, ethical risks and employment impacts.
body: Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki convened the first meeting of the Working Group on Coordination of AI Risk Governance on Friday to advance the territory's artificial intelligence risk governance strategy.

The working group was announced in the 2026 Policy Address, with Chan assigned to coordinate efforts across policy bureaux. He said that while AI is developing rapidly and promoting industry upgrades, managing its societal impacts and prioritising risk governance and application safety are equally important.

At the meeting, the group reviewed and coordinated work plans for seven specific actions: combating the use of AI in criminal activities, enhancing protection for minor users, promoting market assessment of ethical issues, ensuring safe and orderly application across industries, examining legal liability from accidents caused by automated products, introducing guidelines on agent management, and evaluating the impact of automation on employment.

Members include the Secretaries for Justice, Education, Financial Services and the Treasury, Innovation, Technology and Industry, Labour and Welfare, and Security, along with the Head of the Chief Executive’s Policy Unit and the Commissioner for Digital Policy.
The group will meet regularly to monitor progress and coordinate cross-departmental matters.

zh.headline: 陳國基主持人工智能風險管治統籌工作組首次會議
zh.dek: 政務司司長表示，工作組將統籌七項行動，涵蓋打擊AI犯罪、保護未成年使用者及研究就業影響。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周五召開人工智能風險管治統籌工作組首次會議，全面推進人工智能風險治理策略的統籌協調工作。
工作組源於2026年《施政報告》的宣布，由陳國基統籌各政策局推進相關工作。他表示，人工智能發展迅速，在推動產業升級及便利生活的同時，其對社會各領域的影響，以及風險治理和應用安全同樣至關重要。
會議上，工作組檢視及統籌七項具體行動的工作計劃和落實方案，包括打擊利用人工智能犯罪、加強保護未成年使用者、推動市場評估人工智能道德風險、推動各行業安全有序應用、研究人工智能產品導致意外的法律責任、推出指引管理人工智能智能體，以及研究人工智能帶來的就業影響。
工作組成員包括律政司司長、教育局局長、財經事務及庫務局局長、創新科技及工業局局長、勞工及福利局局長、保安局局長、特首政策組組長及數字政策專員。
工作組將按進度定期開會，檢視及督導各項措施落實情況，並統籌跨部門事宜。
